field_edits.updated_text: Stable semisolid nodule in the right upper lobe (series 4, image 165). Stable centrilobular and paraseptal emphysematous changes of both lungs. Stable scattered parenchymal fibrosis and scarring in both lungs. No focal airspace consolidation. The central airways are patent.

The heart is grossly normal in size. Stable left dual‑lead cardiac pacemaker with leads terminating over the right atrium and right ventricle. No pericardial effusion. Stable mild to moderate coronary artery calcifications. Stable mild to moderate atherosclerotic calcification of the thoracic aorta. No thoracic aortic aneurysm. The great vessels are normal in caliber.
New moderate to severe hepatic steatosis. Stable few splenic calcifications. The remaining visualized upper abdominal structures are grossly unremarkable.
Stable thoracic spondylosis. No acute or destructive osseous abnormality. The soft tissues are within normal limits.
